issues.where: Search tree, ply-1 ring (all frames, clearest at 18 s and 34 s on the left and bottom of the inner ring)
issues.problem: The ply-1 nodes are hollow circles sized by subtree, and they overlap into chains of crossed outlines. The innermost ring is the messiest part of the hero panel and you can't count the root moves on it.
issues.fix: Fill the ply-1 dots with a darker copper or steel centre and cap the radius so neighbours fit the available angle (r ≤ π·R1/n − 1 px). Or nudge them radially into two staggered sub-rings when they would collide.

issues.where: Search tree, ply-1 labels along the bottom edge (34 s: Na4 / Ne4 / Nb5 near x 860–1040, y 745–780)
issues.problem: Three labels sit next to each other, so their score and node strings almost touch ('≤-4.60 611k ≤-4.60 1.1M'). It's hard to tell which number belongs to which move.
issues.fix: Add a simple collision pass for labels: sort by angle, push overlapping boxes apart tangentially, and if there's no room drop the label of the smallest subtree.

issues.where: Engine output (UCI), top and bottom rows at 2 s
issues.problem: Mid-scroll, the first and last log rows are cut in half by the header and the panel's bottom edge. They look clipped rather than scrolled.
issues.fix: Snap the scroll offset to whole line heights. Or add a 6 px fade mask at the top and bottom of the log viewport so partial rows dissolve instead of being cut.

issues.where: Root moves, Δ badge on the played move (18 s, 34 s, 49 s: next to the PV row)
issues.problem: At this font size 'Δ0' reads as '40', which looks like a 40 cp loss on Fischer's best moves. The PLAYED tag from the brief isn't there, so the meaning is lost.
issues.fix: Render it as 'PLAYED Δ0' (or 'PLAYED 0cp') in the badge, using a Δ glyph from Segoe UI Variable at 1 px larger. Or drop the Δ and write 'cpl 0'.

issues.problem: Because the PV move is pipelined, a depth-11 line ('11 29 2 cp -491') is printed between depth-12 lines. To a chess viewer the depth column looking non-monotonic reads as a bug.
issues.fix: Hold pipelined results until their iteration becomes current and print them then. Or tag them in the log (dim, prefixed 'ahead') so the order is explained.

issues.where: Top bar NPS chip (all four frames)
issues.problem: Total NPS reads exactly '7.2M' at 2, 18, 34 and 49 s, so the chip looks frozen even though the deep/bg split changes.
issues.fix: Show two decimals (7.21M) or a 1 s moving value with a tiny sparkline under the chip, so the steady throughput visibly flickers.

issues.where: Search tree, Node types inset vs tree header (18 s)
issues.problem: PV 34 + CUT 7,328 + ALL 1,770 = 9,132, but the header and the nodes-per-ply inset both say 9,155 nodes (at 2 s it matches to within 1).
issues.fix: Classify every drawn or stored tree node, counting unresolved or pending nodes as a fourth 'open' category shown in the inset, so the counts add up exactly.

issues.where: Aspiration inset and root-moves header at 2 s
issues.problem: The scout bound reads 0.00. The documented rule (3rd-best previous score − 25 cp) with Nb5 +0.37 / Nb1 +0.25 / Rfe8+ +0.17 gives −0.08. At the other three frames the rule holds.
issues.fix: Check that the scout bound shown is the one actually used. If the bound came from the previous iteration, label it 'scout bound (d8)', or recompute the display from the same previous scores the table shows.

issues.where: Worker lanes, time axis (18 s and 34 s)
issues.problem: Iteration labels pile up near 'now' (for example 'd5 d10 d12 d13 d14'), with no gap between neighbours. The '−8 s d13' pair at the left edge runs together too.
issues.fix: Skip iteration labels that would fall closer than about 18 px to the previous one (keep only the tick line), and give '−8 s' its own fixed slot.

issues.problem: The brief promises the 8 workers 'visibly pin threads'. The measured per-thread loads are spread over 2–98% and don't read as 8 busy cores, so the link to the worker lanes is invisible.
issues.fix: Keep the real data, but add a Σ CPU line or label (for example '≈ 7.6 of 16 threads busy') and an 8-thread reference band to the 4×4 grid header so the pinning shows up as a total.

issues.where: UCI options strip and perft line (x 8–568, y 690–775)
issues.problem: The option stat counters (6.6M, 2.3M, 85%) and the perft ms / Mnps figures are about 8 px grey on brown. No zoom view covers this area and it can't be read in the recording.
issues.fix: Raise them to 9–10 px in the muted colour at higher contrast (#B5A48C), or point one camera zoom at the options/perft band.

critic.summary:
I'd post this almost as is, but it needs a polish pass first. The analysis-room look matches the brief closely: maple and walnut, brass numerals, dense panes, and the radial tree as the hero. The chess is right in every frame. The positions after 16.Bc5, 17.Kf1, 18.Bxb6 and 19.Kg1 match the real game. The engine finds Be6, Bxc4+ and Ne2+ itself, and the material labels (+8, +5) check out. The numbers hold together:
- Worker nodes × 8 equal the top-bar total (448M, 556M).
- The tree's per-ply counts add up to the header total.
- The aspiration δ doubles with the fail count.
- TT memory is 8 × 32 MB.

Every region changes between frames, and nothing looks like a loading or intro state. The problems are all small:
- The ply-1 hollow circles overlap into a mess, and a few tree labels crowd each other.
- At 2 s, log rows are cut in half mid-scroll.
- The 'Δ0' badge reads as '40'.
- Pipelined depth-11 lines appear between depth-12 lines in the log.
- The total-NPS chip shows 7.2M in all four frames, so it looks frozen.
- Some small counts are slightly off: node types don't add up at 18 s, and the scout bound at 2 s doesn't follow the stated rule.
- The perft and option stats are too small and faint to read.
